information_updates.finding: GB/T 44194-2024 is directly relevant to Worldshepherd additive manufacturing because it governs metal-powder reuse strategy, testing and process control and applies to powder-bed fusion and directed-energy deposition contexts.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 44194 is a standard number and does not reinforce the physical 41494 neighborhood.

information_updates.finding: GB/T 44109-2024 provides a current national-standard reference for implementing big-data governance, useful for formalizing ownership, quality, lineage, policy and governance processes across Worldshepherd data systems.
DIN SPEC 91404 provides a maintenance-process standardization reference that complements S3000L lifecycle-support analysis and can help normalize maintenance workflow definitions before automation.
PRICE provides a reusable targeted-assembly algorithmic pattern: iteratively retrieve relevant neighboring data, perform localized assembly and collapse redundant products through meta-assembly.
